scope: fixed cases; not random-trial success probabilities

normal.protocol: V10 flat outlier repair comparison, V8 landing geometry (shorter stair flight, outer plateau); phase telemetry enabled. Nine terrains, matched default joint/root states verified across policies. No noise or pushes; fixed10ms delay. 83 cases per policy: 20 all-direction flat starts (6s budget), seven other terrain types at L6/L9 and vx0.3/0.6/1.2, pit0.15/0.25/0.35/0.45/0.6/0.9/1.2m at vx0.3/0.6/0.9 (25s budget). No heading feedback. Pit external stop retained. 50Hz trajectories plus per-step 200Hz torque/speed/hard-limit peaks. Fixed cases, not success probabilities over random trials.

flat25.protocol: 25-second all-direction flat evaluation on level 80 m square patches. 20 fixed cases per policy, direct or 2-second settled start; no 4m early completion. No noise/pushes; fixed10ms delay. Physical termination remains active; all terrain geometry is flat in this protocol; nine-terrain validation is separate.
